cs.t: +1! I love their Inkplate 2 - quite affordable, color eink, wifi (via esp32). Absolutely super fun and affordable.
cs.th: $2 WeAct Display FS adds a 0.96-inch USB information display to your computer

cs.t: Soldered Inkplate is a solid option for anyone wanting a device with Wi-Fi, backlight, touch screen, battery, and runs arduino or micro python. Recently set one up as a display that updates if I'm in a meeting or free that I hang on my office door.
